content.short: Thunes runs a direct payment network reaching wallets, bank accounts and cash points in over 140 countries.
content.description: Thunes built its own network of direct connections instead of relying on correspondent banking, which is why a payment through it lands in real time in places where a wire would take days. Members can reach mobile wallets, bank accounts, cards and cash pickup points across more than 140 countries and 90 currencies, with over 720 members on the network. Founded in Singapore in 2016, it sells to banks, money transfer operators and platforms rather than end users. Payouts directly into stablecoin wallets were added on top of the same network.
